records.title: Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System (IPEDS)
records.excerpt: The annual NCES collection of institution-level information from postsecondary institutions participating in federal student-aid programs.
records.body: IPEDS is the Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System administered by the National Center for Education Statistics. Institutions report aggregated information through interrelated survey components during the Fall, Winter, and Spring collection periods.
records.use: Use this definition when describing the federal reporting program, not as a synonym for one individual survey component.

records.title: IPEDS survey component
records.excerpt: One of the interrelated institutional reporting questionnaires completed during an IPEDS collection period.
records.body: An IPEDS survey component is a defined reporting instrument such as Completions, Fall Enrollment, Student Financial Aid, or Finance. Each component has its own reporting period, instructions, edit specifications, and applicable import layout.
records.use: Use the component code and collection year together when identifying a submission package.

records.title: IPEDS collection periods
records.excerpt: The three official periods in which institutions complete different groups of IPEDS survey components.
records.body: IPEDS work is organized into Fall, Winter, and Spring collection periods. A collection period describes when a component is reported; it is not necessarily the same as the academic term or data reference period used by that component.
records.source: NCES Timing of IPEDS Data Collection
records.use: Use these labels for the IPEDS reporting calendar. Use census term or academic year when describing the underlying data period.

records.title: IPEDS keyholder
records.excerpt: The institutional user responsible for coordinating, entering, reviewing, locking, and submitting IPEDS data.
records.body: The IPEDS keyholder is the institution's designated reporting official in the NCES Data Collection System. EduInsight can prepare, validate, document, and seal a package, but it does not replace the keyholder's responsibility to review and submit accurate data.
records.use: Use this role as the final human control before an IPEDS component is locked in DCS.
related: IPEDS package approval and keyholder handoff

records.title: IPEDS explanation edit
records.excerpt: A data-quality edit that requires the institution to explain a value or change that is plausible but outside an expected range.
records.body: An explanation edit does not automatically mean the reported value is wrong. It asks the institution to verify the value and document why the exception is accurate, or to correct the data if the edit exposed an error.
records.source: NCES IPEDS survey materials and edit specifications
records.use: EduInsight stores the triggering edit and the written institutional explanation with the sealed approval record for keyholder review.

records.title: IPEDS context box
records.excerpt: Optional explanatory text used to help data users understand unusual institutional circumstances behind a reported value.
records.body: A context box provides information for data users and is different from an edit explanation used to clear a validation condition. Institutional reporters should write concise, factual context and avoid confidential or personally identifiable information.
records.use: Use only when the context helps external users interpret published institutional data.

records.title: Official Fall census
records.excerpt: The institutionally certified snapshot date used to determine the reportable Fall enrollment population.
records.body: The official Fall census is the governed snapshot of registrations after the institution's add/drop policy is applied. Late registrations, withdrawals, nonreportable activity, and other exclusions follow the effective census policy.
records.source: Official Census Date and Enrollment Reporting Policy
records.use: Use the certified snapshot, not a live registration total, for official Fall headcount reporting.

records.title: Fall enrollment headcount
records.excerpt: Distinct active students enrolled at the official Fall census date after reportable-population exclusions.
records.body: Fall enrollment headcount counts each reportable student once in the certified Fall census population, regardless of the number of sections in which that student is enrolled.
records.use: Use for Fall point-in-time enrollment. Do not substitute 12-month unduplicated headcount.

records.title: 12-month enrollment
records.excerpt: Unduplicated enrollment across the institution's defined 12-month reporting period.
records.body: The IPEDS 12-month Enrollment component reports an unduplicated headcount and instructional activity for the applicable July-through-June reporting period. It is not the same population as a single Fall census snapshot.
records.use: Use for annual unduplicated enrollment and instructional-activity reporting.

records.title: First-time, full-time cohort (FTFT)
records.excerpt: Students entering the institution for the first time who are enrolled full time and are degree- or certificate-seeking under the governed cohort rules.
records.body: FTFT is a cohort classification, not a synonym for all new students. Each member must satisfy first-time, full-time, degree/certificate-seeking, entry-period, and applicable exclusion rules.
records.use: Use as the starting cohort for the governed first-year retention calculation.

records.title: Adjusted cohort
records.excerpt: The original cohort after permitted exclusions are documented and applied.
records.body: An adjusted cohort begins with the governed entering cohort and removes only allowable exclusions supported by the source record and reporting definition. Every exclusion must remain traceable.
records.use: Use as the denominator for first-year retention.

records.title: First-year retention
records.excerpt: The share of an adjusted entering cohort that is enrolled or completed by the following Fall census.
records.body: EduInsight's governed first-year retention rate divides retained or completed members of the prior Fall FTFT cohort by the adjusted prior FTFT cohort.
records.numerator: Adjusted-cohort members enrolled or completed by the next Fall census
records.use: Use for cohort-based retention; do not interpret it as course persistence or graduation rate.

records.title: Completion
records.excerpt: A recognized postsecondary credential awarded by the institution.
records.body: A completion is an award earned, such as a certificate or degree. One student may generate more than one completion when multiple reportable awards are earned.
records.use: Use completion count for awards. Use completer count when counting distinct people.

records.title: Completer
records.excerpt: A student who earned at least one reportable award during the reporting period.
records.body: A completer is a distinct individual. A student with multiple awards is one completer but may contribute multiple completion records.
records.use: Use when the requested unit is people rather than credentials.

records.title: Classification of Instructional Programs code (CIP)
records.excerpt: A six-digit NCES taxonomy code used to classify fields of study and program completions.
records.body: CIP codes organize instructional programs into a nationally consistent taxonomy. EduInsight validates the numeric xx.xxxx format and maps each governed academic program to the applicable code.
records.use: Use for IPEDS Completions reporting and consistent field-of-study classification.

records.title: IPEDS award level (AWLEVEL)
records.excerpt: The IPEDS code identifying the type of credential awarded.
records.body: AWLEVEL classifies a completion by credential level, such as certificate, associate's, bachelor's, master's, or research doctorate. Only codes allowed by the current Completions specification may be emitted.
records.use: Use with CIP and student demographic codes to construct Completions import cells.

records.title: DFW outcome
records.excerpt: A course outcome of D, F, or withdrawal (W) within the governed grade population.
records.body: DFW is an institutional course-outcome grouping. The eligible grade population and withdrawal treatment must remain consistent with the governed course-outcome contract.
records.use: Use DFW count for actual outcomes and DFW rate for the proportion of eligible outcomes.

records.title: DFW rate
records.excerpt: DFW outcomes divided by all eligible course outcomes in the selected population.
records.body: The DFW rate measures the share of eligible course outcomes recorded as D, F, or W. It is distinct from the number of DFW students or outcomes.
records.calculation: eligible DFW outcomes ÷ all eligible course outcomes
records.numerator: Eligible D, F, and W outcomes
records.use: Use for comparing outcome proportions; use DFW count when measuring workload or number of affected outcomes.

records.title: Pell-eligible student
records.excerpt: A student whose governed financial-aid attributes indicate Pell eligibility, whether or not a Pell Grant was awarded.
records.body: Pell eligibility and Pell receipt are separate governed attributes. Eligibility must not be substituted for the count of students actually awarded Pell aid.
records.use: Use for institutional subgroup analysis. Use Pell recipient for IPEDS aid-award reporting.

records.title: Pell recipient
records.excerpt: A student recorded as having been awarded a Federal Pell Grant in the governed aid source.
records.body: Pell recipient status is based on the governed award record used for Student Financial Aid reporting. It is narrower than Pell eligibility.
records.source: NCES Student Financial Aid survey component
records.use: Use for Pell-recipient counts and award amounts in the SFA component.

records.title: First-generation student
records.excerpt: A student meeting the institution's governed parental-education definition for first-generation status.
records.body: First-generation status is an institutional analytic attribute derived from governed student information. It is not assumed from Pell eligibility, residency, or another demographic field.
records.use: Use for governed subgroup analysis when the source attribute is present.

records.title: Residency category
records.excerpt: The governed domestic or international residency classification attached to a student record for institutional analysis.
records.body: Residency is a governed analytic dimension. Domestic and international categories are applied from the uploaded student source and must not be inferred from race/ethnicity, program, or name.
records.use: Use for enrollment comparisons when residency data are complete and the requested population is explicit.

records.title: Program capacity utilization
records.excerpt: Filled seats divided by available seats across the active sections associated with a program.
records.body: Program capacity utilization measures the share of governed instructional capacity currently occupied. It is not a forecast and does not by itself establish whether a program should grow or contract.
records.use: Use for instructional planning alongside enrollment demand, course mix, and faculty availability.

records.title: Full-time equivalent (FTE) enrollment
records.excerpt: A calculated student workload measure that converts reported instructional activity into an equivalent full-time enrollment value.
records.body: Full-time equivalent enrollment is a calculated workload measure and is not a count of distinct students. The applicable IPEDS calculation depends on the instructional-activity and reporter rules for the survey component.
records.calculation: Applicable annual instructional activity divided by the NCES annualizing divisor, plus separately reported professional-practice doctoral FTE when required
records.numerator: Reportable undergraduate and graduate credit-hour activity, undergraduate clock-hour activity, and separately reported professional-practice doctoral FTE as applicable
records.denominator: The annualizing divisor required by the current IPEDS 12-month Enrollment instructions for the institution's calendar and activity type
records.use: Use for workload and resource metrics when FTE is requested. Do not label it as student headcount.

records.title: First-time student
records.excerpt: A student attending a postsecondary institution for the first time at the applicable level under the governed reporting rules.
records.body: First-time status is an entry classification. It must be resolved from the governed prior-attendance and entry records and should not be inferred merely because a student is new to a program or appears in the current source for the first time.
records.source: NCES IPEDS glossary and survey materials
records.use: Use with attendance status and degree/certificate-seeking status when constructing FTFT and admissions populations.

records.title: Gateway course
records.excerpt: A governed course designation identifying an early or required course whose completion is important to progression in a program.
records.body: Gateway-course status comes from the governed course catalog or institutional policy. It is not inferred from a high enrollment or DFW rate alone.
records.use: Use when comparing course outcomes or capacity for the institutionally designated gateway-course population.

records.title: IPEDS Student Financial Aid (SFA)
records.excerpt: The IPEDS component reporting student counts and amounts for applicable aid and military-benefit categories.
records.body: The SFA component reports counts of students awarded specified types of aid and the associated amounts for defined undergraduate categories, plus applicable military education benefits. Eligibility and receipt remain separate concepts.
records.source: NCES Student Financial Aid survey component
records.use: Use the current SFA specification and governed award records when preparing counts, amounts, percentages, and averages.

records.title: Data-quality finding
records.excerpt: A governed rule result identifying records or aggregates that require correction, investigation, review, or suppression.
records.body: A finding records the rule, affected records, severity, source, owner, and lifecycle status. A finding is evidence of a condition requiring review; it is not automatically proof that the source value is wrong.
records.use: Use the current operational lifecycle states Open, In Review, Resolved, and Suppressed. Historical process wording must not be presented as an active lifecycle state.

records.title: Official Census Date and Enrollment Reporting Policy
records.excerpt: Defines the census snapshot, late-registration treatment, and exclusions used for official institutional enrollment reporting.
records.body: Official reporting uses the certified census snapshot and governed inclusion rules. Corrections after certification require traceable review rather than silently changing previously published totals.
records.use: Apply before computing official Fall enrollment or reconciling source extracts.

records.title: IPEDS annual specification control
records.excerpt: Requires each collection year's forms, instructions, edit specifications, code tables, and import layouts to be reverified before use.
records.body: EduInsight pins every generated package to a collection year and specification identifier. The annual refresh is a controlled review of current NCES materials; the application does not silently assume that a prior-year layout remains valid.
records.source: NCES current and archived survey materials
records.use: Complete before opening each reporting cycle and again if NCES posts a material update.
related: IPEDS package approval and keyholder handoff

records.title: Material variance review and explanation
records.excerpt: Requires a written institutional explanation when a valid year-over-year change exceeds the governed review threshold.
records.body: The reporter first verifies the current and prior values. If the change is caused by an error, the data are corrected. If the change is accurate, the reporter writes a concise factual explanation and the explanation is stored with the sealed package approval.
records.source: IPEDS edit-review workflow and EduInsight approval control
records.use: Use for material year-over-year edits; never invent a cause that is not supported by institutional evidence.
related: IPEDS package approval and keyholder handoff

records.title: IPEDS package approval and keyholder handoff
records.excerpt: Defines the human approval gate used to freeze, hash, and transfer a validated package to the institutional IPEDS keyholder.
records.body: A package can be marked ready only after it is complete, generated, structurally validated, reconciled, reviewed for material variances, and tied to the acknowledged annual specification. The approval record retains the file hash, approver, time, validation summary, and explanations.
records.use: Use as the final internal control before the human keyholder uploads and locks the component in NCES DCS.

records.title: Student-level privacy boundary
records.excerpt: Restricts EduInsight to governed aggregate analytics and refuses requests for identifiable student-level information.
records.body: EduInsight does not return student names, identifiers, or sensitive row-level lists through Ask EduInsight. Aggregate reporting, controlled sample rows for authorized data-quality review, and IPEDS cells follow separate governed access paths.
records.use: Apply before any analytical execution or disclosure.

records.title: IPEDS Fall Enrollment 2024–25
records.excerpt: Prior certified Fall Enrollment package with its source extracts, validation notes, approvals, and revision history.
records.body: This record is the governed prior-cycle reference used for year-over-year comparison. Current-year reporters must still follow the current specification and should not copy prior values without source reconciliation.
records.use: Use for prior-year comparison, revision review, and audit evidence.

records.title: Computer Science capacity review
records.excerpt: Prior analysis of graduate demand, gateway-course utilization, faculty load, and instructional capacity.
records.body: The review combines governed enrollment and section-capacity measures. It supports planning discussion but does not establish causation or function as an enrollment forecast.
records.use: Use as prior evidence when evaluating current Computer Science demand and capacity.

records.title: Student success evidence inventory
records.excerpt: Evidence mapped to institutional-effectiveness standards, including disaggregated outcomes and documented action plans.
records.body: The inventory identifies the governed metric, source snapshot, responsible owner, review status, and decision evidence supporting each institutional-effectiveness claim.
records.use: Use to locate certified evidence without redefining the underlying metric.
